name: Beef Curry
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 1 225gm can of crushed pineapple with juice

steps: Dice onions, combine with curry powder and cook in frying pan using oil.
Cut meat into bite sized cubes and brown in frying pan.
Remove and add to casserole dish.
Prepare carrot, parsnip, and apple by peeling and cutting into cubes.
Cook in 150 C oven for 120 minutes.
Serve with rice, and condiments such as banana, peanuts, sultanas, pineapple pieces, sliced tomatoes, and sliced cucumber.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
